items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: No, but I heard something about her name like that. George Foster.

ctx.x: You know George Foster out there in the country? He's from up around Macau, further up the river.
No, but I heard something about her name like that. George Foster.
He came into the city later, and then he went on up to Chicago and New York. I think he's out in San Francisco now. Oh, yeah. He's out there working with a little man.
